notes.title: v1.0 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Kungfu Cowboy is officially out of Early Access!!

We are celebrating our full release with 30% off. Grab a copy with your friends from 7/30 until 8/6!

Thank you to all our players who have supported us throughout development. 

We couldn't have done it with you guys! 

With love,
Soy Boy Games.
